title: Compound Notify
tagline: Compound Notify - standalone application with a user-friendly interface to configure alerts
description:
Our standalone application is designed to be versatile and user-friendly, offering a seamless integration as an extension. It allows users to effortlessly receive email notifications for important events. The application's intuitive interface ensures a hassle-free experience, empowering users to stay informed and never miss out on significant updates.

With our application, users can easily configure their notification preferences and select the events they want to be notified about. By connecting their email accounts, they can receive timely alerts directly to their inbox.

In summary, our user-friendly standalone application seamlessly integrates as an extension, providing email notifications for important events.
how_its_made:
With QuickNode's Alerts feature, you gain the ability to receive webhook events. 

Following this, the logs from these events are decoded and filtered to extract the desired event information, which is subsequently transmitted as email notifications. 

Furthermore, our Next.js application enables users to conveniently select specific events and input their preferred email addresses for receiving alerts.
